name: Tenant restrictions (Microsoft Entra)
short_description: Tenant restrictions in Microsoft Entra prevent users from signing in to other, external Microsoft 365 or Entra tenants with corporate devices or networks, reducing the risk of data exfiltration; universal tenant restrictions enforce this through Global Secure Access.

evidence.quote: Here's another feature. Tenant restrictions. Think of it as a digital fence that keeps your data where it belongs.
